name: FONTAINE'S ANTI CHEAT (FAC)
teaser: Removes equipped gear/loot if you alt-F4 during a raid.
description_html:
Full credit to Fontaine (here’s the original mod page), I have only updated this mod

Fontaine’s Anti-Cheat (FAC)

Inspired by Fin’s old anti-cheat mod, but this is entirely written by Fontaine.

Find yourself spamming alt-F4 when you die in a raid to avoid losing your gear because you lack self-control? I sure have. This mod will delete the gear/loot you went in with and found if you don’t exit a raid properly (except secured container and special slots obviously). So if you alt-F4, or the game crashes, you will lose your gear, just like live!

DISCLAIMER: I AM NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR ANYTHING THAT HAPPENS TO YOUR PROFILE/LOOT/GEAR OR ANY SALT INDUCED. USE AT YOUR OWN RISK. ALWAYS BACK UP PROFILES REGULARLY.
